# A smash trap's random dir from its create event decides the player's throw when he touches it before it has
# slid (851-3493, docs/quirks.md §1), and the wiki clip quirks/smash-trap-random-throw. A staged scene (written by
# wiki-clips --replays from a scene spec, docs/wiki-media.md): it boots, loads this custom level from the title's
# load-level menu (240), and plays the scene's inputs from 241, its frame 0. The player (@) stands on a ledge
# beside a one-block gap, and a smash trap (+, x 112, y 96) sits on the far side of it:
#   1111111111111111111111
#   1000000000000000000001
#   1000000000000000000001
#   1000000000000000000001
#   1000@00000000000000001
#   111110+111111111111111
#   1111111111111111111111
# With seed 1 the trap's create event's rand(0,3) makes its dir 1 (DOWN). He walks right (263), steps off the ledge and
# drops into the gap against the trap's side. On 269, at (107, 91), above the trap's row and outside its
# column, so the trap hasn't moved (status 0), oPlayer1's step finds him touching it: 10 hearts (he's dead), xVel
# 4, toward it, and, because the resting trap's dir is still the random 1, yVel 4 (down) instead of -6. Thrown
# down into the trap's row, he sets it off: it slides left (271, dir 2), hits his body on each step from 276
# with yVel -6 now, and crushes it (279).
# story: oSmashTrap.dir=1@240..240 !oSmashTrap.status=1@..270 oPlayer1.yVel=4@269..269 oPlayer1.xVel=4@269..269
# story: oPlayer1.dead=1@269..269 oSmashTrap.status=1@271..271 oPlayer1.yVel=-6@276..276
